articles.title: GameSpot Veteran Lucy James Quits to Launch Game Discovery Newsletter with Geoff Keighley’s Player.gg
articles.summary: After 12 years at GameSpot, Lucy James is launching lookingfor.game, a newsletter that sends PC game demos to your inbox. She’s partnering with Geoff Keighley’s new platform, Player.gg, which aims to streamline game discovery with Steam integration and personalized recommendations.

articles.title: The MacBook Neo’s Ripple Effect: Dell Nails the Budget Premium Laptop, Microsoft Fumbles
articles.summary: Apple’s $599 MacBook Neo disrupted the laptop market, and now Dell’s new XPS 13 copies its formula with a premium aluminum build and 8 GB RAM for $699. Microsoft’s upcoming Surface Laptop, however, may repeat the 8 GB spec at a much higher price, missing the point entirely.

articles.title: Overwatch’s Pride Comic Gives Lifeweaver a New Romance, Sinking a Popular Fan Ship
articles.summary: Overwatch’s 2026 Pride event features a comic starring Lifeweaver and Venture, introducing Lifeweaver’s new love interest, Dr. Palak Nathani. The story dashes years of fan hopes for a Lifeweaver/Baptiste romance, continuing Blizzard’s pattern of pairing queer heroes with NPCs rather than each other.
